name: benchmark-vidore-v3-energy
description: A benchmark for evaluating models on energy-related video understanding tasks (classification/regression) collected as part of the vidore-v3 energy suite. It measures a model's ability to recognize and/or predict energy-related events or attributes from short video clips, emphasizing temporal and visual feature understanding relevant to energy contexts.
reputation: Small, dataset-level benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited citation and community use to date.
